newsitem.title: THAILAND: Burma opposition gathering seen small affair.
newsitem.headline: Burma opposition gathering seen small affair.

text.p: A meeting by Aung San Suu Kyi's opposition party on Tuesday is set to be a small affair because of efforts by Burma's military rulers to block members from attending, sources said.
Security officials refused to allow two National League for Democracy (NLD) members of parliament to enter Suu Kyi's lakeside residence on Monday, the NLD sources said.
